description: Ask for a house on its own VM for the person you act for. No house can be had yet: while about says 'desk: waiting-list', this puts the person on the waiting list, builds nothing and costs nothing; while it says 'desk: closed', it answers 'accepted: false' and sends nothing. This sends an e-mail to a person: call it only when they know it is coming. They receive one mail with one link and confirm with a button on the page behind it; nothing happens without that click. Returns a ticket to follow with house_status.

email.description: E-mail address of the person who will confirm and own the house. One address, name@domain.tld.

language.description: Language of the mail and of the page the person confirms on: 'en' or 'de'. Default 'en'.

size.description: Size of the machine: 'economy' (small VM) or 'premium' (larger VM). Both run the same software. Default 'economy'.

name: request_house

accepted.description: True if the request was taken and a ticket exists. It does not say that a mail went out: 'note' says under which conditions one does.

note.description: What happened and what to do next.

ticket.description: The ticket of the request. Null if it was not accepted.

address.description: The address of the house once it exists. Null before.

id.description: The ticket id; pass it to house_status.

state.description: One of: requested (waits for the person's click), confirmed (the person clicked), expired (not confirmed in time), declined (the person said no); later: building, trial, licensed, dormant, exported, deleted.

title: Request a house
